description: Analyze repositories and store their graphs in SQLite
commands: check

Check current sources against atlas.json in the analyzed folder, without saving by default. Missing keys inherit defaults: maxFileLines=600, maxFunctionLines=100, maxParameters=3, maxWeightedComplexity=8, maxDecisionDepth=3, maxNestedLoops=0, maxCircularImportGroups=0. maxChangeImpact and maxInstability are disabled by default and apply to files/modules. Null disables a check. Equality passes; violations exit 1.
graph
Read an indexed graph as JSON; unresolved targets are not classified as external. Stable keys retain their indexed spelling.
index
Analyze a folder and save its graph in SQLite
mutations

Derive independent JSON byte-edit manifests, never change source or save results. Opt in via atlas.json: mutations.rules is a list of rule IDs. Default/empty lists generate nothing. --rules lists exact language coverage. Conditions, unary operators and unlisted aliases are excluded. Syntactic support is not type validity.
projects
List all registered projects as JSON
report
Analyze a folder and show quantitative metrics as Markdown or JSON, without saving by default

commands: run

Apply independent mutations and run trusted configured test commands in this workspace. No baseline or isolation is provided. Nonzero command exits count as killed. Results are incremental JSONL with separate command logs. Each run overwrites previous results. Progress is printed to stderr; stdout remains JSON.
